question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Count the imported functions: undefined, nonempty-named .dynsym symbols with any @version suffix removed. Submit the count in base 10.

answer_format.syntax: base-10 integer with no units, separators, whitespace, or explanatory text

oracle_cmd: readelf --dyn-syms -W gf_c_imports.bin | awk '$7=="UND" && $8!=""{sub(/@.*/,"",$8); print $8}' | sort -u | wc -l
